name: Chicken mi quang
summary: Mì Quảng with chicken, a bowl said to have a taste found nowhere else in Cư M’gar and Krông Pắc.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 says a bowl of mì Quảng gà or mì Quảng ếch in Cư M’gar or Krông Pắc has a taste found nowhere else.
howToEat: This is the highland districts’ bowl, not the Da Nang one.
seoTitle: Mi quang ga — chicken mi quang in Cu M'gar
seoDescription: Chicken mi Quang from Cu M’gar and Krong Pac, a highland bowl, not the Da Nang one.
